jobs.title: Insider Threat Analyst
jobs.description_text: INSIDER THREAT ANALYST SpaceX is seeking a dynamic and driven individual with a demonstrated ability to work independently and as a member of a team in a fast-paced, high-tech environment. Our goal is to protect some of the world’s most advanced technologies including rockets, Dragon capsules for human transport, inter-planetary transport vehicles, the world's largest satellite communications network, etc. As an industry leader, we are a target of adversaries, both foreign and domestic, focused on slowing us down and accessing our proprietary technology. The work we do will literally safeguard mankind becoming an interplanetary species. You will be responsible for the research, analysis, production, and dissemination of information relevant to protecting the safety and security of personnel, brand, global assets, intellectual property, and operations at SpaceX. This role will triage anomalous event data and analyze insider threat program datasets to respond to threats posed to SpaceX. You will use comprehensive understanding of various collection methods and platforms to explore new data sources, build effective queries, and combine information from disparate sources. Aerospace experience is not strictly required - we are looking for smart, motivated, collaborative engineers who love solving problems and want to make an impact on an inspiring mission. jobs.description_text: SOFTWARE ENGINEER, ALERTS (STARLINK) Starlink operates the world's largest satellite constellation, and must maintain operational control over them at all times. As a member of the Alerts team, you will be responsible for the entire alerting system, ensuring this critical operational data is created, processed, and delivered quickly, correctly, and reliably so that the right person can understand and correct the problem. You will have a direct impact on the ability of Starlink to safely scale operations to a million+ satellites and hundreds of millions of users. Your contributions will allow engineers to sleep at night, knowing that if an issue arises that requires their attention, they will be woken up. Our software engineers are responsible for the life cycle of the software they create, including development, testing, and operational support. The tower the largest steel structure ever built to support a launch vehicle. It must survive the acoustic, thermal, and blast environment of the most powerful rocket in the world at liftoff, absorb the loads of catching a returning booster, and then be ready to do it again within days. As the Structural Engineer on the Tower team, you will own the structural integrity of these structures from concept through fabrication, erection, activation, and launch operations. You will perform and own the structural design and analysis of primary and secondary steel, connections, anchorage, and foundation interfaces; develop and issue drawings, calculations, and specifications; and lead consulting engineers, fabricators, and construction contractors through engineering, procurement, fabrication, construction, and commissioning. You will work hand in hand with the mechanical, mechanisms, fluids, and analysis engineers on the team to ensure the structure meets requirements for both the design and the manufacturing and integration processes.
